blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 当前多式联运 大语言模型(MLLMs)已经迅速进步并遵循了两大范式:一是将可视化和文字符号相接以输入大语言模型(LLM),而一是将可视化知识注入了LLM的Feed-Forward Network(FFNs). 然而,前者引入了大量冗余的视觉符号,大大增加了计算间接费用. 后者缩短了序列长度,但将图像完全从输入阶段去除,这可能会阻碍图像相关知识的激活. 此外,由于跨模式语义差异,天真地将视觉知识注射到FFN中可以诱发活性分布转变. 为了应对这些挑战,我们开发了Beyond Token Stacking(BTS),这是MLLMs的新视觉增强框架. 具体来说,我们提出一个多尺度可视化模组(MVM)机制,通过调制在输入阶段注入多尺度可视化信息而不会增加符号序列长度. 此外,我们开发了一个适应性纤维-外观校正模块,进行每道外缘校正,将视觉注射从FFN分层的配正中解开,提高多式聚变稳定性,同时保留语言前缀。 实验显示我们的方法实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: In recent years, the rapid advancement of LLMs ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ) has significantly propelled the evolution of MLLMs ( Hurst et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2023 ) , enabling them to handle multiple modalities ( i.e. , text, images, video, and audio). Notably, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) ( Song et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , which integrate pretrained visual encoders with LLMs, have achieved impressive results on a range of multimodal tasks, including image caption ( Ke et al., 2019 ) and visual question answering ( Antol et al., 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: 近年来,LLMs(Touvron等人,2023年;Achiam等人,2023年)的快速发展大大推动了MLLMs(Hurst等人,2024年;Dai等人,2023年)的演化,使它们能够处理多种模式(即文本、图像、视频和音频). 值得注意的是,Visual-Langage Models(VLMs)(Song et al.,2025;Song et al.,2024;Wang et al.,2024)整合了预先训练的视觉编码器与LLMs,在包括图像标题(Ke et al.,2019)和视觉问答(Antol et al.,2015)在内的多种模式任务上取得了令人印象深刻的成果.

blocks.en: To effectively align and fuse visual and linguistic representations, VLMs typically rely on full-parameter fine-tuning. However, as the parameter scales of both visual and language models grow exponentially, full fine-tuning that updates most or all parameters requires substantial training memory and computational costs. To mitigate this challenge, researchers have explored parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for VLMs ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Jie et al., 2024 ; Sung et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2022a ; Hao et al., 2025 ) , where pretrained backbones are largely kept frozen and only a small set of lightweight modules is updated. Depending on how visual information is incorporated into the LLM, existing methods can be categorized into two paradigms, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了有效地使视觉和语言表达一致并相互连接,VLM一般依赖于全参数的微调. 然而,随着视觉模型和语言模型的参数尺度呈指数增长,全面微调,以更新大多数或所有参数,需要大量的训练内存和计算成本. 为缓解这一挑战,研究人员探索了VLMs的参数效率微调(PEFT)(Luo等人,2023年;Jie等人,2024年;Sung等人,2022年;Hu等人,2023年;Chen等人,2022年a年;Hao等人,2025年),其中预先训练过的骨干基本被冷冻,只有一套轻量级模块更新. 如图1所示,视视觉信息如何纳入LLM而定,现有方法可分为两个范式。

blocks.en:
(i) Concatenation : This paradigm ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Sung et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2023 ) projects the output of the visual encoder into the input space of the language model via linear projection, then concatenates the visual prompts with text embedding tokens, and finally feeds the combined sequence as a whole into the LLM. Although the above methods preserve relatively rich visual information, the large number of visual tokens often exhibits substantial redundancy. For example, an image encoded by ViT/14 produces up to 196 patch tokens, whereas the accompanying text is typically far shorter, averaging 12.84 tokens on GQA ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) and 6.3 tokens on VQAv2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) . (ii) Visual Knowledge : This paradigm ( Jie et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Hao et al., 2025 ) injects visual knowledge into the FFN layers of the LLM to avoid input sequence-length inflation. However, these approaches lack visual contextual information at the input stage , which may reduce the likelihood of activating image-related knowledge.
Meanwhile, the injected visual features are usually extracted at a single granularity, making it difficult to capture both global structure and fine-grained details. In fact, robust visual grounding often benefits from multi-scale information that captures both global semantics and fine-grained details.
Additionally, due to the inherent semantic gap and mismatched feature statistics between vision and language ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , naively injecting visual features into the FFN layers could perturb activation distributions, inducing distribution shifts and compromising the stability of cross-modal feature fusion ( Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015 ) .
blocks.zh:
(一) 协和: 这个范式(Luo et al., 2023;Sung et al., 2022;Hu et al., 2023)通过线性投影将视觉编码器的输出投射到语言模型的输入空间中,然后用文字嵌入符使视觉提示调和,最后将组合序列整体输入LLM. 虽然上述方法保存了相对丰富的视觉信息,但大量的视觉符号往往表现出大量的冗余. 例如,由ViT/14编码的图像可产生多达196个补丁符号,而随附的文本一般要短得多,平均在GQA(Hudson and Manning, 2019)和VQAv2(Goyal等人, 2017)上可产生6.3个符号. (二)视觉知识: 这种范式(Jie等人,2024年;Gao等人,2023年;Hao等人,2025年)向LLM的FFN层注入视觉知识,以避免输入序列长膨胀. 然而,这些方法在输入阶段缺乏视觉背景信息,这可能降低激活图像相关知识的可能性。
同时,注射的视觉特征通常在单一颗粒度下提取,因此很难同时捕捉到全球结构和细纹细节. 事实上,稳健的视觉地面往往受益于既能捕捉全球语义又能捕捉精细细节的多尺度信息.
此外,由于视觉和语言之间固有的语义差距和不匹配的特征统计(Yin等人,2024年),天真地将视觉特征注入FFN层可能干扰激活分布,诱导分布转移,并损害跨模式特征聚变的稳定性(Ioffe和Szegedy,2015年).

blocks.en:
To address the aforementioned issues, in this paper, we develop a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs named BTS. Our method consists of two key components: (1) Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) : Since FFN-based visual knowledge injection methods lack explicit and rich visual contextual priors at the input stage, we propose MVM mechanism. Specifically, we perform multi-stage downsampling on the visual encoder outputs to extract multi-scale visual information that integrates coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained details. We then employ a lightweight adapter to modulate these multi-scale features into a visual bias, which is injected into text token embeddings in a residual manner. This design introduces multi-scale visual information into the language model without increasing the token sequence length. (2) Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) : To mitigate the activation distribution perturbations induced by visual knowledge injection in the FFN layers, we introduce AFC module. AFC adaptively calibrates fused features via per-channel affine transformations to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment, where the injection branch contributes cross-modal gains and the calibration branch restores activation statistics to a stable and controllable regime. Consequently, AFC achieves a more reliable multimodal fusion process and maintains the linguistic priors of the LLM.
We conduct systematic evaluations of BTS on multiple multimodal benchmarks, and extensive experimental results show that BTS significantly enhances the multimodal understanding capability of the model. Overall, our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
为了解决上述问题,我们在本文件中为名为BTS的MLLMs开发了一个新的视觉增强框架. 我们的方法包括两个关键组成部分: (1) 多尺度视觉调制(MVM): 由于基于FFN的视觉知识注射方法在输入阶段缺乏明确和丰富的视觉背景前科,我们提出MVM机制. 具体来说,我们在视觉编码器输出上进行多阶段的下采样,以提取多尺度的视觉信息,将粗细的纹理语义与细细的纹理细节融合在一起. 然后我们使用一个轻量级适配器来调制这些多尺度的特性,形成视觉偏差,这种偏差以剩余的方式注入文字符号嵌入. 这种设计在不增加符号序列长度的情况下,将多尺度视觉信息引入语言模型. (2) 适应性引信特性校准(AFC): 为了减轻视觉知识注入在FFN层引起的激活分布扰动,我们引入了AFC模块. AFC适应性校准了通过每通道的芬化转化而成的引信特性,将视觉注射与分布式对齐脱钩,其中注入分支促进跨模式增益,校准分支将激活统计恢复到稳定和可控制的制度. 因此,AFC实现了更可靠的多式联运聚变过程,并保持了LLM的语言前传.
我们对多种多式联运基准进行系统评估,广泛的实验结果表明,BTS大大加强了该模式的多式联运理解能力。 总体而言,我们的贡献概述如下:

This module effectively mitigates activation distribution shifts induced by visual knowledge injection and improves the effectiveness of multimodal feature fusion. • We conduct extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmarks. BTS achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating its effectiveness.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1. 多式大型语文模式

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models unify modalities such as vision and language within a single framework, enabling end-to-end perception and reasoning. Early work primarily relied on cross-modal contrastive learning ( e.g. , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and ALBEF ( Li et al., 2021 ) ) or encoder-decoder pre-training architectures ( e.g. ViLBERT ( Lu et al., 2019 ) , LXMERT ( Tan and Bansal, 2019 ) , and Unified VLP ( Zhou et al., 2020 ) ) to learn vision-language representations. Recently, an increasing number of studies have shifted toward efficiently integrating visual information into LLMs to support image understanding, multi-turn dialogue, and complex reasoning. For instance, Flamingo ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ) achieves modality bridging by introducing gated cross-attention between pre-trained vision and language models; BLIP ( Li et al., 2022 ) proposes a unified vision-language pre-training framework that supports both understanding and generation; BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023 ) further employs the Q-Former to bridge a frozen visual encoder and a frozen LLM; LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ) constructs a general-purpose visual assistant through visual instruction tuning; and works such as PaLI ( Chen et al., 2022b ) , Kosmos-1 ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and InternVL ( Chen et al., 2024 ) continue to expand general multimodal capabilities and visual reasoning performance using larger-scale data and stronger components. Despite the substantial progress made by these methods in multimodal capabilities, the cost of full fine-tuning has become increasingly prohibitive as the scale of vision and language models continues to grow exponentially.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型将视觉和语言等模式统一在一个框架内,使端到端的感知和推理成为可能. 早期工作主要依靠跨模式对比学习(如CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)和ALBEF(Li等人,2021年))或编码器-解码器预训架构(如ViLBERT(Lu等人,2019年),LXMERT(Tan and Bansal,2019年),以及统一VLP(Zhou等人,2020年))学习视觉语言表达. 最近,越来越多的研究转向有效地将视觉信息纳入LLMS,以支持图像理解、多回合对话和复杂的推理。 例如,Flamingo(Alayrac等人,2022年)通过在预先培训的视觉和语言模型之间引入门式交叉注意,实现了模式的衔接;BLIP(Li等人,2022年)提出了一个支持理解和生成的统一视觉语言培训前框架;BLIP-2(Li等人,2023年)进一步利用Q-Former连接一个冷冻的视觉编码器和冷冻LLLLM;LLAVA(Liu等人,2023年)通过视觉指导调制构建了一个通用视觉助理;以及PALI(Chen等人,2022b),Kosmos-1(黄等人,2023年),InternVL(Chen等人,2024年)等工程继续利用更大的数据和更强的组件,扩大通用多式联运能力和视觉推理性能。 尽管这些方法在多式联运能力方面取得了实质性进展,但随着愿景和语言模式的规模继续指数增长,全面微调的成本越来越高。

blocks.en: 2.2. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2. VLMs的参数-有效微调

blocks.en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning techniques achieve rapid adaptation to downstream tasks by updating only a small number of learnable parameters or introducing lightweight auxiliary modules, while keeping the majority of pre-trained weights frozen. These methods have been widely adopted for task transfer in the vision ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ; Jie and Deng, 2023 ; Jie et al., 2023 ) , language model ( Houlsby et al., 2019 ; Zaken et al., 2022 ; Pfeiffer et al., 2021 ) , and multimodal model ( Jiang and Zheng, 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Jie et al., 2024 ) domains. PEFT methods for VLMs have demonstrated competitive performance. Depending on how visual information is fused into the LLM, these methods can be broadly categorized into two paradigms. The first paradigm ( e.g. , VL-Adapter ( Sung et al., 2022 ) , VL-PET ( Hu et al., 2023 ) , and LaVIN ( Luo et al., 2023 ) ) projects image features into visual prompt tokens, concatenates them with text tokens, and feeds the resulting sequence into the LLM, while fine-tuning only the projection layer and the PEFT modules inserted into the LLM. However, these methods still suffer from efficiency bottlenecks due to redundant visual tokens. The second paradigm ( e.g. , MemVP ( Jie et al., 2024 ) and LLaMA-Adapter v2 ( Gao et al., 2023 ) ) remove image from the input stage and instead treat it as an external visual knowledge injected into the FFN layers of the LLM. However, completely ignoring images at the input stage may lead to insufficient activation of knowledge, especially since text-only semantic modeling can introduce ambiguity in tasks that require integrating textual and visual information. Moreover, fusing visual features at the FFN layers may disrupt the activation distribution of the pre-trained language model and still struggle to address the issues of representation misalignment and activation distribution drift caused by cross-modal semantic differences.
blocks.zh: 参数有效 微调技术通过仅更新少量可学习的参数或引入轻量级辅助模块,同时保持大多数预训重量的冻结,实现了快速适应下游任务. 这些方法在愿景中被广泛采用(Rebuffi等人,2017年;Jie and Deng,2023年;Jie等人,2023年),语言模型(Houlsby等人,2019年;Zaken等人,2022年;Pfeiffer等人,2021年)和多式联运模型(Jiang and Zheng,2023年). 2023; 罗等, 2023; 吉等, 2024)域. 针对VLM的PEFT方法表现出了竞争性的性能. 根据视觉信息如何融入LLM,这些方法可以大致分为两个范式. 第一个范式(例如,VL-Adapter(Sung等人,2022年)),VL-PET(Hu等人,2023年),以及LaVIN(Luo等人,2023年)将图像特征投射到视觉的即时信号,用文字信号将其缩合,并将产生的序列输入LLM,同时只微调插入LLM的投影层和PEFT模块. 然而,由于视觉标志的冗余,这些方法仍然受到效率瓶颈的影响. 第二个范式(如:MemVP(Jie等人,2024年)和LLaMA-Adapter v2(Gao等人,2023年))从输入阶段去除图像,转而把它当作注入LLM的FFN层的外部视觉知识. 然而,在输入阶段完全忽略图像可能导致知识的激活不足,特别是因为仅文本语义模型化可能会在需要整合文本信息和视觉信息的任务中引入模糊性. 此外,FFN层的引信视觉特征可能会干扰预训语言模型的激活分布,仍然难以解决跨模式语义差异引起的表达错配和激活分布漂移问题.

3.2. FFN with Visual Knowledge
blocks.zh: 3.2. 具有视觉知识的FFN

blocks.en: Previous work interprets FFNs in pre-trained language models as key-value memory that stores and retrieves factual associations ( Geva et al., 2021 ; Dai et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) . However, these studies have focused on purely textual models, leaving visual knowledge integration underexplored. Recently, MemVP ( Jie et al., 2024 ) addressed this gap by encoding visual knowledge into additional keys and values within FFNs, providing language models with externally visually conditioned knowledge.

blocks.en: 4. Method
blocks.zh: 4个 方法

blocks.en:
We propose BTS, a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs, as illustrated in Figure 2 . (a) We first strengthen early visual grounding by introducing multi-scale visual context at the input stage. Specifically, MVM provides both coarse and fine visual information, where the coarse information capture global layout and scene structure, while the fine information preserves local details. This design allows the language model to establish visual understanding at an early stage, rather than deferring visual reasoning to deeper layers. (b) Furthermore, we improve the stability of cross-modal fusion within the FFN layers through feature calibration. Since cross-modal injection could easily perturb the activation statistics of the LLM, AFC performs lightweight feature calibration to keep fused activations within a well-behaved range. This makes cross-modal fusion more robust and prevents visual signals from drifting the residual stream away from the pretrained linguistic regime.
In summary, BTS activates richer visual context early for better grounding and maintains stable fusion during FFN injection, enhancing multimodal reasoning.

(b) 此外,我们通过特性校准,提高福尔多涅地层内跨模式聚变的稳定性。 由于跨模式注射可以很容易地干扰LLM的激活统计,因此AFC进行轻量级特征校准,使引信的激活保持在良好的范围内。 这使得跨模式聚变更加坚固,防止视觉信号漂移残余溪流脱离预先训练的语言系统.

blocks.en: 4.1. Multi-scale Visual Modulation
blocks.zh: 4.1. 多尺度视觉模块

blocks.en: Existing methods such as MemVP ( Jie et al., 2024 ) inject visual information only within the FFN layers of the LLM, while the input stage remains purely textual. This results in a lack of explicit visual contextual priors during early processing, making it difficult to activate image-relevant factual knowledge and fine-grained visual information promptly. Consequently, later layers face greater pressure for cross-modal alignment and information retrieval. Based on this issues, we propose the Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism, which extracts multi-scale visual features and converts them into a lightweight residual bias injected at the input stage, furnishing the LLM with earlier, more explicit, and richer visual priors.
blocks.zh: MemVP(Jie et al., 2024)等现有方法仅在LLM的FFN层内注入视觉信息,而输入阶段仍纯粹为文字. 这导致早期处理过程中缺乏明确的视觉背景前科,使得难以迅速激活与图像相关的事实知识和精细的视觉信息. 因此,后几层面临更大的压力,要求进行跨模式协调和信息检索。 基于这些问题,我们提出了多尺度视觉模组(MVM)机制,该机制提取多尺度视觉特征,并将其转化为输入阶段注入的轻量级剩余偏差,为LLM提供更早,更清晰,更丰富的视觉前身.

blocks.en: 4.2. Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration
blocks.zh: 4.2. 适应性引信特性校准

blocks.en:
Based on the perspective that FFN can be viewed as key-value memory stores for factual knowledge ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , we treat visual knowledge as new memory entries and inject it into FFN layers to compensate for the lack of vision-related knowledge in language models. Concretely, from the FFN standpoint, visual features are converted into additional key-value pairs ( K ⁡ ( z i ) , V ⁡ ( z i ) ) (K(z_{i}),V(z_{i})) and written into the FFN retrieval space. This augments the original language-fact memory with visually conditioned knowledge support, expanding the capacity of the model for vision-grounded facts. After inserting visual memory entries, the output of the FFN can be formulated as the joint retrieval of both linguistic and visual memories: (8) F ​ F ​ N ​ ( x ) = ∑ i = 1 D ϕ ⁡ ( ⟨ x , k i ⟩ ) ⋅ v i + ∑ i = 1 n ϕ ⁡ ( ⟨ x , K ⁡ ( z i ) ⟩ ) ⋅ V ⁡ ( z i ) , FFN(x)=\sum_{i=1}^{D}\phi\!\left(\langle x,k_{i}\rangle\right)\cdot v_{i}+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\phi\!\left(\langle x,K(z_{i})\rangle\right)\cdot V(z_{i}), where z i z_{i} denotes visual feature, and K ⁡ ( z i ) K(z_{i}) and V ⁡ ( z i ) V(z_{i}) are its corresponding visual key and value, respectively.
However, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFN layers may lead to representation misalignment and activation distribution drift due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To this end, we propose an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module, which performs per-channel affine transformation on the fused activations to adaptively calibrate their distribution. This decouples visual injection from distribution alignment, thereby improving the stability and controllability of the fusion process.

blocks.en: 5.1. Dataset and Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1. 数据集和实验设置

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments primarily on ScienceQA ( Lu et al., 2022b ) , which contains 21k multimodal multiple choice questions with rich domain diversity across 3 subjects, 26 topics, 127 categories, and 379 skills. The dataset is split into training,
validation, and test splits with 12726, 4241, and 4241 examples, respectively, and we report average accuracy on the test set. In addition, following prior work ( Luo et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , we further evaluate our method on multiple VQA benchmarks, including GQA ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) , VQAv2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) , OKVQA ( Marino et al., 2019 ) , and VizWiz ( Gurari et al., 2018 ) . We use LLaMA-7B and LLaMA-13B ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) as the language backbones, together with CLIP ViT-L/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) as the vision encoder. Following the training setup of MemVP ( Jie et al., 2024 ) , we train the models for 20 epochs using the AdamW optimizer, with a batch size of 32 and a learning rate of 9e-3. The positional embedding length is set to 320 for LLaMA-7B and 400 for LLaMA-13B. For samples without image inputs, we set the visual prompts to zero tensors. The learnable scalar gate α \alpha is initialized to 0, and tanh ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \tanh(\cdot) limits the injection strength to ( − 1 , 1 ) (-1,1) , which stabilizes training and prevents visual modulation from overriding language priors. All experiments are conducted in a single-stage end-to-end setting, where answers are generated directly from the inputs. Experiments are implemented in PyTorch 2.0 and conducted on RTX A800 GPU.

blocks.zh: 5.2. 比较方法

blocks.en: We compare with two categories of methods: (1) MLLM methods. We compare our method with representative vision-language models spanning diverse architectures, including BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023 ) , Flamingo ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ) , InstructBLIP ( Dai et al., 2023 ) , IDEFICS ( Laurençon et al., 2023 ) , UnifiedQA ( Lu et al., 2022a ) , LLaVA/LLaVA-1.5 ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , InternVL ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , Qwen-VL/Qwen2-VL ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , GPT-3.5 ( Lu et al., 2022b ) , GPT-4 ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) and MM-CoT ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) . (2) PEFT methods. We further compare our method with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, including LLaMA-Adapter ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , LLaVA-LoRA ( Jie et al., 2024 ) , LaVIN ( Luo et al., 2023 ) , MemVP ( Jie et al., 2024 ) , ADEM-VL ( Hao et al., 2025 ) , and IPK ( Song et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 5.3. Results Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3. 成果分析

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , under the same LLaMA-7B backbone, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on ScienceQA, reaching an average accuracy of 93.59%. It outperforms strong PEFT baselines, including MemVP (93.07%), ADEM-VL (92.88%), LaVIN (89.41%), LLaVA-LoRA (90.85%), and LLaMA-Adapter (85.19%). When scaled to LLaMA-13B, our method further improves the average accuracy to 94.35%, again surpassing the existing baselines. Particularly, under the 7B setting, our method improves over MemVP by 0.35%, 0.23%, and 1.09% on NAT, SOC, and LAN, respectively, and also achieves gains of 0.49% and 0.75% on the TXT and IMG evaluations. Similar trends are observed under the 13B setting, where the improvements are particularly pronounced on LAN and TXT. This suggests that our method not only provides richer and earlier visual contextual support, but also effectively mitigates distributional perturbations introduced by cross-modal fusion, improving overall multimodal understanding while preserving language capabilities.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,在同一个LLaMA-7B主干线下,我们的方法实现了ScienceQA的先进性能,平均精度达到93.59%. 它的绩效超过了强有力的PEFT基线,包括MemVP(93.07%)、ADEM-VL(92.88%)、LaVIN(89.41%)、LLaVA-LORA(90.85%)和LLaMA-Adapter(85.19%)。 当被放大到LLaMA-13B时,我们的方法将平均准确度进一步提高到94.35%,再次超过了现有的基线。 特别是,在7B环境下,我们的方法在NAT、SOC和局域网上分别比MemVP提高了0.35%、0.23%和1.09%,在TXT和IMG评价上也提高了0.49%和0.75%。 在13B背景下也观察到类似的趋势,局域网和TXT的改进特别明显。 这表明,我们的方法不仅提供了更丰富和更早期的视觉背景支持,而且有效地缓解了跨模式聚变带来的分布扰动,提高了整体的多式联运理解,同时保留了语言能力.

blocks.en: Furthermore, to evaluate the generalization capability of the proposed method, we conduct experiments on multiple VQA benchmarks, as shown in Table 2 . Our method achieves competitive performance on GQA, OKVQA, and VizWiz, achieving 66.3%, 52.5%, and 72.5%, respectively. In particular, the improvements on GQA and VizWiz indicate that our method is effective not only in modeling visual-semantic relationships in complex scenes, but also in handling low-quality and noisy real-world images more robustly. Overall, these results further demonstrate that our method generalizes well on ScienceQA and across diverse VQA tasks.
blocks.zh: 此外,如表2所示,为了评价拟议方法的一般化能力,我们进行了多种VQA基准的试验。 我们的方法在GQA,OKVQA和VizWiz上实现了竞争性表现,分别达到66.3%,52.5%和72.5%. 特别是GQA和VizWiz的改进表明,我们的方法不仅在复杂场景中的视觉语义关系建模方面是有效的,而且在更有力地处理低质量和吵闹真实世界的图像方面也是有效的. 总体而言,这些结果进一步表明,我们的方法很好地概括了科学质量保证和各种VQA任务。

blocks.en: 5.4. Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.4. 阅读研究

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of each component, we conduct ablation studies on OKVQA, VizWiz, and SQA. As shown in Table 3 , introducing only MVM (# 0) achieves 52.1%, 70.8%, and 93.2% on OKVQA, VizWiz, and SQA, respectively, indicating that introducing multi-scale visual context at the input stage helps activate image-related knowledge. In contrast, using only AFC (# 1) provides relatively limited gains. Moreover, based on MVM, employing only unilateral calibration (# 2 or # 3) is inferior to bilateral calibration, suggesting that AFC plays complementary stabilizing roles at two critical stages of FFN-based visual retrieval. As a result, combining MVM with AFC (# 4) achieves the best results, further validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
blocks.zh: 为了验证每个部分的有效性,我们对OKVQA,VizWiz和SQA进行了减缩研究. 如表3所示,仅在OKVQA,VizWiz和SQA上引入MVM(# 0)分别实现52.1%,70.8%和93.2%,表明在输入阶段引入多尺度视觉环境有助于激活图像相关知识. 相比之下,仅使用AFC(# 1)则提供相对有限的收益. 此外,基于MVM,只使用单边校准(#2或#3)低于双边校准,说明AFC在基于FFN的视觉检索的两个关键阶段发挥互补的稳定作用. 因此,将MVM与AFC(# 4)相结合,可以取得最佳效果,进一步验证拟议方法的有效性.

blocks.en: We further ablate the scale settings of MVM. As shown in Table 4 , using only fine-grained features ( i.e. , [256]) performs worse than combining fine-grained and coarser context ( i.e. , [256, 64]), indicating that the multi-scale priors introduced by MVM provide richer visual context and help the model leverage both coarse-grained semantics and fine-grained information. Adding an additional coarser scale ( i.e. , [256, 64, 16]) slightly degrades performance, suggesting that introducing too many scales may add redundancy.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步降低MVM的尺度设置. 如表4所示,仅使用细纹特征(即[256])的性能比结合细纹和粗纹上下文(即[256,64])的性能更差,表明MVM引入的多尺度前缀提供了更丰富的视觉上下文,并帮助模型同时利用粗纹语义和细纹信息. 添加一个额外的折合比额(即[256,64,16])会略微降低性能,说明引入过多的比额可能增加冗余.

blocks.en: To evaluate the adaptability of our method across different LLM backbones, we conduct comparative experiments using LLaMA-7B and Vicuna-7B. As reported in Table 5 , our method achieves the best performance under both settings, attaining 93.59% on LLaMA-7B and 92.51% on Vicuna-7B, respectively. Compared with ADEM-VL and MemVP, our method improves performance on both backbones, demonstrating its robustness across diverse LLM backbones. It is also worth noting that the performance on Vicuna-7B is slightly lower than that on LLaMA-7B. A possible explanation is that Vicuna, which undergoes additional instruction fine-tuning based on LLaMA, is optimized for dialogue alignment and instruction following, and may therefore not fully preserve the original representation space that proves more suitable for visual question answering tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们的方法在不同LLM主干线上的适应性,我们使用LLaMA-7B和Vicuna-7B进行了比较实验. 如表5所示,我们的方法在这两种情况下都取得了最佳业绩,分别达到LLaMA-7B和Vicuna-7B的93.59%。 与ADEM-VL和MemVP相比,我们的方法提高了两个骨干上的性能,显示了它在不同LLM骨干上的强性. 还值得注意的是,Vicuna-7B的性能略低于LLaMA-7B. 一种可能的解释是,Vicuna在LLaMA的基础上接受额外指令的微调,被优化用于对话对齐和后续指令,因此可能无法完全保留被证明更适合视觉问答任务的原始表示空间.

(2) Multi-object counting: in cluttered scenes, prior methods miss or double-count objects, whereas our method produces the correct count. (3) Occlusion and distractors: under heavy occlusion, our method localizes the key evidence and makes the correct prediction. (4) Visual degradation: in low-quality blurred grayscale images, our method still captures appropriate visual cues to correctly identify the vehicle as a “Bus.” In general, these cases suggest that our method can more reliably retrieve and utilize visual information under challenging conditions.

blocks.en: Figure 4 visualizes the attention distribution on visual tokens in the final layer of the LLM when addressing VQA multimodal questions. As shown in the visualization, for counting queries ( e.g. , “How many giraffes are there?”), the highest attention concentrates on the local grid cells containing the giraffes, exhibiting a clear instance-centric focusing behavior. In contrast, for localization queries ( e.g. , “Where are the umbrellas?”), the attention forms a contiguous, band-like pattern aligned with the umbrellas’ contours, clearly delineating the target’s spatial extent even under cluttered backgrounds. Similarly, for the question “what street name is on the lower sign?”, the attention is highly concentrated on the lower sign region. For the question “Is this a commercial airplane?”, the attention mainly covers the airplane itself rather than the background. These observations collectively suggest that our method can improve vision-language alignment across diverse visual reasoning scenarios.

blocks.en: 5.7. Analysis of AFC
blocks.zh: 5.7. 分析金融公司

blocks.en: We visualize the distributions of per-channel activation standard deviation before and after AFC at the two FFN projections (down and up) across five VQA benchmarks ( i.e. , GQA, VQAv2, OKVQA, VizWiz, and SQA), as shown in Figure 5 . The blue bars (“pre”) represent the distributions before applying AFC, while the orange bars (“post”) represent those after AFC. It can be observed that the calibration effect is most pronounced at AFC@down. Across all datasets, the post-AFC distribution shifts toward lower values and becomes more concentrated than the pre-AFC distribution. This shift indicates that the original distributions exhibit heavy tails with high - variance channels. AFC effectively suppresses these tails, demonstrating its ability to dampen abnormal responses induced by cross - modal injection and to reduce channel - wise variance imbalance, thereby limiting the propagation of distribution drift. In contrast, AFC@up shows substantial overlap between the pre- and post-AFC curves, with only minor adjustments. This suggests that the output - side calibration is conservative, primarily aimed at bringing the fused features back into a numerically stable range compatible with the pretrained residual stream, preventing small mismatches from accumulating across layers and eroding linguistic priors. Overall, these results indicate that AFC decouples visual injection from statistical alignment and stabilizes cross-modal feature fusion across diverse benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,我们将每个通道激活标准偏差在两个FFN预测(向下和向上)在五个VQA基准(即GQA、VQAv2、OKVQA、VizWiz和SQA)上的分布可视化。 蓝色条(“前”)在应用AFC之前代表分布,而橙条(“后”)则代表AFC之后的分布。 可以看到,校准效应在AFC@down中最为突出. 在所有数据集中,AFC之后的分布转向较低的值,并且比AFC之前的分布更加集中. 这一转变表明,最初的分布呈现出带有高-差异通道的重尾巴. AFC有效抑制了这些尾巴,表明它能够抑制跨式注射引发的异常反应,并减少信道的明智差异不平衡,从而限制分布漂移的传播。 相比之下,AFC@up显示AFC前后的曲线有相当的重叠,只有微小的调整. 这表明,输出-侧校准是保守的,主要目的是将引信的特征带回一个与预先训练的残余流相适应的数值稳定的范围,防止小的错配层间累积,并侵蚀语言学前科. 总体而言,这些结果表明,AFC将视觉注入与统计调整脱钩,稳定了跨模式特性在各种基准之间的融合。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a visual enhancement framework that tackles two limitations in current MLLMs: (i) redundant visual tokens and high computation from token concatenation, and (ii) FFN-based visual knowledge injection that lacks early visual context and could cause activation distribution drift. BTS comprises two key components. First, Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) extracts multi-scale visual context from vision encoder outputs and injects it as a lightweight residual bias into text embeddings, enabling earlier visual grounding without introducing extra visual tokens. Second, Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) calibrates fused activations via per-channel affine transformations, stabilizing FFN-based visual injection and improving fusion robustness. Extensive experiments across multiple multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that BTS substantially enhances both multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出Beyond Token Stacking(BTS),这是一种视觉增强框架,它解决了当前MLLM的两个局限性:(一) 冗余的视觉符号和从符号凝聚中高计算,(二) 基于FFN的视觉知识注入,缺乏早期视觉上下文,可能导致激活分布漂移. BTS包括两个关键组成部分. 首先,多尺度视觉模具(MVM)从视觉编码器输出中提取多尺度视觉上下文,并将它作为轻量级剩余偏差注入文字嵌入,使得早期的视觉地面能够不引入额外的视觉符号. 第二,适应性纤维-环境校准(AFC)通过每通道的亲缘转化实现引信激活,稳定基于FFN的视觉注射,提高聚变强度. 跨越多种多式联运基准的广泛实验表明,BTS大大加强了多式联运的理解和推理能力。
